name: glob-dot-pattern
script:
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern")
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/sub/deep")
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/pkg.app/Contents")
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/Empty")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/a.txt")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/B.TXT")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/.hidden")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/img.png")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/sub/c.txt")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/sub/deep/d.md")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/pkg.app/Contents/Info.plist")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/zeta.TXT")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/Apple.txt")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/sub/.dot.txt")
glob "$TMP/glob-dot-pattern/.*"

name: backup-destination-inside-source
script:
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/backup-inside/src/sub")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/backup-inside/src/a.txt")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/backup-inside/src/sub/b.txt")
backup (POSIX file "$TMP/backup-inside/src") onto (POSIX file "$TMP/backup-inside/src/Backup") level 1
list files (POSIX file "$TMP/backup-inside/src") as unix path
